+- The suite reports "skipped" when the gate variable is absent.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] With the gate variable set on a host with the models, all cases pass.
+- [ ] With the gate variable absent, `swift test` in `IntegrationTests/` reports the suites as skipped and exits 0.
+- [ ] `CIWorkflowTests` passes with the new inputs.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] The five test files above.
+- [ ] Run `cd IntegrationTests && swift test` (no gate). Expected: skipped, exit 0.
+- [ ] Run `cd IntegrationTests && <GATE>=1 swift test` on a model host. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
